decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed scheme is considered to be a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would result in inadequate room sizes and substandard living accommodation; the proposal would be detrimental to the residential amenity of the occupiers, and detrimental to the residential amenities of the area, by reason of increased noise and vehicular activity, overlooking and loss of privacy, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.2 and Revised Deposit Version (January 2001) UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 and H 4.1.

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposed parking arrangements would fail to meet the Council's parking standards, would compromise pedestrian and cyclist access to the site, and would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5, and Revised Deposit Version (January 2001) UDP policy T.1.4.
description: ERECTION OF A TWO-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION AND ROOF EXTENSION TO SHOP TO CREATE A NEW SELF CONTAINED OFFICE AT GROUND FLOOR LEVEL AND 3 STUDIO FLATS AT FIRST AND SECOND FLOOR LEVELS WITH ASSOCIATED PARKING
